essentiel.titre: ICJ finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya
essentiel.resume: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed state-sponsored genocide against the Rohingya minority during the 2017 military crackdown. The landmark verdict represents the first time an international court has found a state guilty of genocide.
